create_PureDocAttention_with_self_attent: create a PureDocAttention module with SelfAttention pooling and a specified embedding dimension
create_PureDocAttention_with_max_pool: create a PureDocAttention module configured with MaxPool pooling instead of self attention
create_PureDocAttention_with_mlp_decoder: create a PureDocAttention module with an optional MLPDecoder for non-linear projection
run_PureDocAttention_forward: run the PureDocAttention forward pass on embedded tokens with optional sequence lengths
review_PureDocAttention_Config: review the PureDocAttention Config class to understand dropout, pooling, and mlp_decoder options
